text: 中共中央政治局常委、全国人大常委会委员长赵乐际5日上午同列席十四届全国人大常委会第二十五次会议的全国人大代表座谈交流。他强调，人大代表要带头学习宣传贯彻党的二十届五中全会精神，立足岗位职责抓好落实，加强自身思想政治和纪律作风建设，提高依法履职能力。
text_en: Zhao Leji, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the National People's Congress Standing Committee, held a discussion and exchange on the morning of the 5th with NPC deputies attending the 25th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee. He stressed that NPC deputies should take the lead in studying, publicizing, and implementing the spirit of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee, implement it in light of their job responsibilities, strengthen their ideological, political, and disciplinary conduct, and improve their ability to perform duties in accordance with the law.
